body:
Real, working PARENA procgen script (internal/nock/examples/bullet_hole.prn) generating a slightly asymmetric bullet-hole decal, with a single tweakable asym-seed parameter controlling shape character (verified: -0.9/0.0/0.9 render visibly different shapes). Live-caught and fixed a real design gap mid-build: NOCK's procgen pipeline has no alpha channel; switched the decal to a white background composited via Multiply blend instead, verified with a real ImageMagick composite test. 2 new regression tests (go:embed'd from the shipped asset). go build/test clean. Commit 90cb8cf.

⚓ ☃
title: Bullet hole decal example script for NOCK
